**Exploring idiomatic phrases**

I’m thinking about the phrase "raise the roof." It fits with a house and raising arms but also has a fun party vibe behind it. I wonder if the main idea is linked to celebration. Another related phrase could be "head in the clouds," which connects with the "head" and "idea" notions, plus there's something about space and clouds along with arms raised high. I guess I could explore up to three phrases related to this!
